Definition: Justice, judgement and ordinance — God's righteous decisions and the just order He requires in courts, community and daily life.
BiblicalUsage: Mishpat is what God requires — 'to do justice, love kindness and walk humbly' — and what corrupt courts perverted. Kings were judged by whether the poor received mishpat under their reign.
TheologicalSignificance: Mishpat shows faith is never private only: the God of justice calls His people to defend the vulnerable. His final judgement means wrongs will not have the last word.
